commit.message: docs: tighten final submission privacy and freshness claims
feat: ship native FCC integration and judge-ready demo

feat: confidential reserves mode — salted commitment keeps the reserves figure off-chain

Per-subject confidentialReserves flag: the reserves endpoint publishes
keccak256(abi.encode(totalReserves, reservesSalt)) instead of the raw total;
the TEE takes reservesSalt as an extra private input and the verifier compares
commitment-to-commitment. Closes the dictionary-attack gap of the unsalted
reserves commitment. Fraud reveal/slashing unchanged. 7 new unit tests (63).

fix: attestation history via Blockscout logs API

The public Coston2 RPC now caps eth_getLogs at ~30 blocks per call, making a
full-deployment RPC scan infeasible. The explorer logs API covers the whole range
in one request; the RPC path remains as a recent-window fallback.

fix: harden verifier and staking per adversarial security review

- SolvencyVerifier: FDC proof bound to an owner-registered per-subject reserves source
  (reservesSourceHash) so an attestor cannot fabricate reserves; recent-timestamp bound;
  lockable FDC verifier override
- raiseFraud reworked: verifies the reveal against the stored inputHash only (reserves are
  fixed at record time), removing the FDC dependency so reserve drift cannot shield a fraud
- AttestorStaking.slash: covers unbonding funds and never reverts on zero (a slash cannot be
  dodged by unstaking; revocation always applies); returns the amount slashed
- orchestrator: CSPRNG nonce/salt, registers the reserves source, fraud reveal without FDC
- remove superseded Phase 3 standalone scripts; 30 contract tests passing
